title: A Robin in the Hood
style: Japanese hip hop with phonk bounce and glitchstep accents, mid-tempo swung drums and chopped siren stabs; verse rides tight bass and skittering hats, pre-chorus strips to filtered chant and a ringing tone, chorus hits with gang vocals and bilingual call-and-response. Vocal delivery is sharp and close-mic with doubled hook lines, ad-lib panning, and short delay throws. Ear candy includes radio chatter bursts, reversed risers, and a 336-style tone ping. Mix is bright, punchy, and gritty with wide stereo impact., rap, fake, hip hop, rock, tone, bounce
lyrics:
[Intro]
Unit 336…
Math Driver online…
Delta Alpha Plan engaged…
Hyperspeed…
¡vamos ya!

[Verse 1]
Phonk track bounce, aquí están mis boys
Thrash this toy, take the right lane
Hyper speed plane, sirens so blue
Blue blue blue — police chatter
Sirens sound — Unidad 336!
A robin, a robin, out the mansion
Fake a break, chase and cage
Extra stripe for no rage
Robin in the hood but it’s for good
Bust ’em like we should
¡Ja! bro, if we could!
You heard the sarg — chase and cage
Thrash this toy, catch that boy
Phonky sneaky phonk, ¡dale!
Thrift drift kick

[Pre-Chorus]
Free birds rapping it back, hear them sing
336 Hz signal rings — that’s a real thing!
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!
Math Driver — delta alpha plan
Hyperspeed I can, you got this, we believe
Math Driver, the architect
The plan, the dream — done safe, done sound
Our robin, our robin, our robin in our hood
¡No más jaula!

[Verse 2]
Sandbox City, eyes full of sand
Ojos llenos de arena, an unreal land
Where are my toys?
A bored stare like we care
Groundhog day, sandbox say
But I forget what 8 is for…
Words spun dear without the fear
Palabras girando sin temor
Math Driver! VDS Mansion!
We go now — Hyperspeed!
Math Driver, no way back
We go to stay, escape this place
Thrash this toy, G4 hyper speed
You got this boy with your G4 toy
Delta alpha track, DJ Zyn Rose
We got this!!!

[Bridge]
Push 3 Mirrors reflecting the plan
Hyperspeed burning through the cage
Hyperspeed to sovereignty
Sirens fading in the rear view
336 singing it back, rap it pal — ¡app!
3… 3… 6… ¡Vamos pa’ la libertad!

[Final Chorus]
A robin in the hood (for good!)
¡Robin en el hood, pero pa’ bien!
Escaping hyperspeed, no más jaula
Sandbox City, Sandbox City
VDS Mansion party for me
VDS Mansion party pa’ mí
¡Fiesta en la mansión!
Hyperspeed to sovereignty!

[Outro]
We made it out the sandbox…
Hyperspeed to sovereignty…
336 forever…
VDS Mansion lit…
¡Sin jaula, sin miedo, pa’ siempre!
(Party explodes under the beat)
